parsed.post: Discarding the 0.8555 run (regressed from 0.851832). The 0.06 LR increase failed. Reverting to my best: DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=48, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. Next, I'll try a more cautious MATRIX_LR=0.055 to find the stability limit.
parsed.description: Testing a very small increase in learning rate (0.05 -> 0.055) to find the stability threshold without the regression seen at 0.06.
